messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Close date fallout analysis and owner assignments

Hi team,

Finance ran a quick reconciliation this morning and flagged ~17 opportunities where the committed revenue on the forecast doesn’t match the current SFDC close date (close date is more than 60 days away OR blank). This is creating a material variance for our June/July forecast and we need to clean up before next week’s commit review.

I attached a short CSV (close-date-fallout-20270611.csv) with the highest-dollar items. Can we triage and take the following actions by EOD Friday 6/18?

- Owner confirm: update the SFDC close date to a realistic date OR
- Archive / convert to prospect if the deal is no longer active
- If the date slips, add a one-line rationale in the Opportunity Chatter and update the Stage to one of the valid pipeline stages (no custom stages)

I started a quick split by ARR buckets in the sheet and suggested owners in the last column — please update if you disagree. For any customer exceptions (enterprise procurement timelines), tag me and I’ll escalate to Rev Ops.

High-level asks:
1) Update these 10 highest-impact opps in SFDC (link below)
2) Confirm by reply to this thread who you re-assigned (if you re-assigned)
3) If you need a 1:1 to clear blockers, ping me and I’ll schedule a 15 minute slot

Salesforce link: https://redwood.my.salesforce.com/00Q5g00000XYZabc
Attachment: close-date-fallout-20270611.csv (CSV, 14KB)

Thanks,

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Thanks Steph — good catch. I pulled the CSV and did a quick pass. I made these immediate assignments and notes in the attached ownership-matrix-20270611.xlsx:

- ACME Corp - "Platform Modernization" (RDW-ACME-5421): assigned to Marcus Lin. Customer requested procurement runbook; they expect Q3 close but want a formal POC in July.
- ByteStream (prospect): owner to remain me; close date set to 2027-09-30 (customer requested longer evaluation window).
- GreenRoof (small ARR): archive as "No recent contact" and move to nurture.

I updated SFDC for the top 6 on the list. For the ACME deal, I left the close date as 2027-09-30 for now but added a Chatter note that we need formal procurement dates. Marcus — can you confirm you’ll own ACME and push procurement contact cadence?

Attachment: ownership-matrix-20270611.xlsx (XLSX, 32KB)
